super6.race: PricedUp Now With Best Odds Handicap Hurdle
super6.comment: Fairly useful Flat performer and easy winner of a thin handicap hurdle at Southwell in May 2025. Making only his second start since when down the field at Sedgefield following another 18 months away last time. Seems fragile but reasonably treated if shrewd yard has him fit and well.

super6.race: Denise Smith Memorial Novices' Limited Handicap Hurdle
super6.comment: Tricky customer who didn't improve as demanded when 19½ lengths third on handicap bow at Market Rasen (20.5f). Hard to be confident the step up in trip will prove the key to him.
Fair maiden unproven beyond 8.5f on the Flat but offered something to work when 10¼ lengths fifth of 13 to Espritroyale in juvenile event at Fairyhouse on debut.

super6.race: Racing Here Again On 3rd December Maiden Hurdle
super6.comment: Fair handicapper on Flat, shaping better than the distance beaten suggested when seventeenth of 22 in handicap at Leopardstown (9f, good to firm) back in August. Market check advised on hurdling debut.

Shaped encouragingly when runner-up in maiden at Southwell (5f) on her third start. Has run to a similar level in a pair of 6f nurseries since, never nearer when 1¾ lengths fifth of 13 back at Southwell last month.

finals.race: William Hill Challenge Series Handicap Chase
finals.comment: Made a successful chasing debut at Downpatrick (2¼m) in September last year. Better than the result only other start over fences this season and opened his hurdles account in a 3m Fairyhouse handicap 23 days ago. Could still have more to offer as a chaser.

Just a maiden win to his name over fences but campaigned mainly at Grade 1 level since, shaping better than the result when sixth of 12 to Fact To File in the Irish Gold Cup in February. Also went well for a long way in the Grand National and can make a bold bid on his return.

finals.race: Denise Smith Memorial Novices' Limited Handicap Hurdle
finals.comment: Tricky customer who didn't improve as demanded when 19½ lengths third on handicap bow at Market Rasen (20.5f). Hard to be confident the step up in trip will prove the key to him.

finals.race: Connolly's RED MILLS Irish EBF Auction & Median Maiden Hurdle
finals.comment: Placed twice in points in 2025 and twice in the frame in 2m maiden hurdles, she should be well suited by this step up in trip and, with progress still very much on the cards, looks set to make a bold bid to open her account.

Fair maiden on the Flat and matched that form on the first attempt over hurdles despite a less than fluent round of jumping when third of 13 behind Espritroyale in juvenile event at Fairyhouse 23 days ago. He's entitled to build on that performance.
Fair maiden unproven beyond 8.5f on the Flat but offered something to work when 10¼ lengths fifth of 13 to Espritroyale in juvenile event at Fairyhouse on debut.

Frustrating sort (well treated on pick of his form) who promised more than he delivered when supported at Market Rasen in late-September. Easy to back/typically not fluent when 7 lengths third off this mark at Warwick (21f) subsequently.

finals.race: Get Raceday Ready Novices' Hurdle (GBB Race)
finals.comment: Progressive sort who made it 2-2 over hurdles with another straightforward front-running success at Wetherby (soft). Beaten only by another fairly useful type on hat-trick bid at Doncaster (16.5f, heavy) in February. Sure to win a novice without a penalty this season, though bumps into one here.

finals.race: Racing Here Again On 3rd December Maiden Hurdle
finals.comment: Fair handicapper on Flat, shaping better than the distance beaten suggested when seventeenth of 22 in handicap at Leopardstown (9f, good to firm) back in August. Market check advised on hurdling debut.

finals.race: William Hill Challenge Series Mares Handicap Hurdle (0-100)
finals.comment: Runner-up twice over hurdles but isn't progressing and there was no encouragement to be gleaned from her recent handicap debut at Clonmel. Hopes pinned on first-time cheekpieces having a positive impact but hard to make a serious case for her otherwise.

finals.race: Midnite A Next Generation Betting App Handicap
finals.comment: Remains a maiden and has struggled for form this year, faring no better in first-time cheekpieces when well held at Wolverhampton (9.5f) in September.
Yet to win but took a step back in the right direction in refitted cheekpieces (retained) with fourth of 8 in handicap at Newcastle (7f) last month. Not out of things on polytrack debut eased 1 lb.

Has taken well to all-weather last 3 starts, dropping back to 5f when doubling his tally at Southwell on first outing this month. Followed up in ready fashion at Newcastle 6 days ago and he's much respected under a double penalty, though does have a tendency to start slowly.
